name: Devson Catalyst Ltd
tagline: Genuine industrial-catalyst niche with a new high-value Ammonia Decomposition Catalyst win (Tata Steel, NMDC), but revenue growth has stalled to ~6% YoY, working capital is blowing out, and customer/export concentration is real — thesis downgraded to neither, Low conviction, still zero public quarters
business_overview: Devson Catalyst (BSE SME, 544823) is an ISO-certified manufacturer of catalysts, adsorbents and ceramic balls used in oil & gas, petrochemical, steel, fertiliser and other industrial process industries, with ~63% domestic / ~37% export revenue (exports concentrated in Kuwait). IPO opened 9 July 2026, listed 16 July 2026. No ValuePickr thread yet; this pass adds screener.in financials, IPO/RHP disclosures and a September 2026 Tata Steel/NMDC order announcement on top of the earlier web/news + old-project baseline.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 443 Cr at Rs 326/share (2026-09-18, up from ~Rs 275-373 Cr at listing)
+30% → +23% → +5.6% YoY — sharply decelerating; FY26 PAT growth (+63%) was margin-driven, not volume-driven
Debtor days 87→110, working-capital days 70→128 in FY26 — elongating despite the revenue slowdown
Top-10 customers = 76% of FY26 revenue; Kuwait alone = ~46% of export revenue (~17% of total)
Listed 16 July 2026 — still zero quarterly results as a listed company (first due ~mid-Nov 2026 for Q2 FY27)
fundamentals_narrative: Pre-IPO fundamentals looked outstanding (ROCE ~57%, ROE mid-40s, almost debt-free) and remain genuinely strong on returns. But this pass's deeper read of the FY24-FY26 numbers shows PAT growth has been margin-driven, not volume-driven: OPM roughly tripled from 11% to 30% while revenue growth decelerated hard, from +30% (FY24) to +23% (FY25) to just +5.6% (FY26). Working-capital days simultaneously blew out from 70 to 128 (debtor days 87→110) — a cash-drag warning that is not explained by growth, since growth itself stalled. Customer concentration (top-10 = 76% of revenue) and export concentration (Kuwait alone ~46% of exports) are real, disclosed risks. The one genuine new positive this pass found is a newly developed, higher-value Ammonia Decomposition Catalyst that has already been deployed at NMDC and won a first commercial order from Tata Steel (announced 4 Sept 2026) — real evidence of in-house R&D capability — though order value/quantity is undisclosed. IPO proceeds (~Rs 17.4 Cr capex + Rs 12 Cr working capital) fund a near-doubling of capacity to 11,293 MTPA from 86.83%-utilised 6,205 MTPA. The company is still two months post-listing with zero public quarterly results.

Customer concentration (top-10 = 76% of FY26 revenue) and export concentration (Kuwait ~46% of exports) are both disclosed and material

verdict_headline: Real ROCE and a genuine new product win (Tata Steel/NMDC) are outweighed by a sharp revenue-growth deceleration, a working-capital blowout, and customer/export concentration — thesis downgraded to neither, conviction stays Low
verdict_reasoning: four_box score is 2.0 (tam=yes on the small base and funded capacity doubling; tailwind, moat both weak; valuation no at 36x P/E against decelerating revenue growth) — per the quickref decision table this requires a written exception to keep a 10x framing, and none applies here: valuation is not 'yes', the most recent full year (FY26, +5.6% revenue) is not a 'strong specific recent quarter', and this is not a large-cap named-inflection case. thesis_fit is therefore neither, not an override

The Tata Steel/NMDC Ammonia Decomposition Catalyst order (announced 4 Sept 2026) is a genuine, evidenced commercial-stage win and the strongest new fact this pass found, but its value is undisclosed and it does not yet offset the FY24-26 revenue deceleration (+30%→+23%→+5.6%) or the FY26 working-capital blowout (WC days 70→128)
No red flag: promoter holding 73.59% with zero pledge, near debt-free, no auditor/litigation issues found — red_flag_tier stays none
Conviction stays Low: real ROCE and a credible new-product proof point are offset by growth deceleration, a cash-drag signal, concentration risk, and still zero quarters as a listed company
Old 108-stock project rated it Tier B; this pass's deeper numbers reinforce that caution rather than resolve it, and move the return-magnitude framing itself from 10x-in-2-3-years to neither

four_box.note: tailwind weak: genuine new-product (green-hydrogen ammonia-cracking) tailwind but core revenue growth stalled to +5.6% FY26. tam yes: tiny ~Rs443cr base with a funded capacity doubling to 11,293 MTPA. moat weak: real in-house R&D (Ammonia Decomposition Catalyst) but high customer (top-10=76%) and export-country (Kuwait) concentration. valuation no: 36x P/E prices continued compounding against a decelerating top line and a margin already at a 3-year high (peak-margin risk).

quality_metrics.note: SME listed Jul 2026. ROCE 57% / ROE 45% latest (43% 3-yr avg); OPM expanded 11%→30% over 3 years; near debt-free (borrowings ~Rs2cr). FCF conversion ~-6% (FY26 CFO Rs5cr, FCF ~-Rs1cr on ~Rs17cr EBITDA) alongside sharp working-capital deterioration — debtor days 87→110, working-capital days 70→128 — that is NOT explained by growth, since FY26 revenue growth itself slowed to +5.6%. capex_efficiency marked unclear because the IPO-funded new plant (11,293 MTPA target) has not yet been built/commissioned — too early to judge whether the new capital earns back above cost of capital; historical capex through FY26 was productive (revenue and OPM both grew), but that track record predates the current expansion. High-ROCE, real R&D (Ammonia Decomposition Catalyst commercial win at Tata Steel/NMDC) but the cash cycle and growth deceleration are now flagged as a concern, not just a watch item.
